log_file.description: Path to the log file for the metadata agent.

log_level.description: Logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_date_format.description: Date format string for log timestamps.

metadata_proxy_socket.description: Unix socket path used to communicate with the metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response from the metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_connect_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a connection to the metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_read_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for data to be read from the metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed metadata proxy operations.

metadata_proxy_retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) between retries (exponential backoff cap).

metadata_proxy_slow_response_threshold.description: Time (in seconds) after which a slow metadata proxy response triggers a warning.

metadata_proxy_stall_threshold.description: Time (in seconds) after which a stalled metadata proxy connection is logged as an error.

metadata_proxy_kill_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before forcibly terminating a stuck metadata proxy connection.

metadata_proxy_restart_delay.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before restarting a failed metadata proxy connection.

metadata_proxy_dead_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a metadata proxy connection is considered dead.

metadata_proxy_stale_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a metadata proxy connection is considered stale.

metadata_proxy_unhealthy_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a metadata proxy connection is considered unhealthy.

metadata_proxy_lost_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a lost metadata proxy connection is treated as failed.

metadata_proxy_failed_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a failed metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_refused_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a refused metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_reset_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a reset metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_closed_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a closed metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_broken_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a broken metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_aborted_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an aborted metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_incomplete_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an incomplete metadata proxy connection is logged.

metadata_proxy_malformed_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a malformed metadata proxy response is logged.

metadata_proxy_unauthorized_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an unauthorized metadata proxy request is logged.

metadata_proxy_forbidden_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a forbidden metadata proxy request is logged.

metadata_proxy_not_found_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a not-found metadata proxy resource is logged.

metadata_proxy_conflict_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a conflict in metadata proxy operation is logged.

metadata_proxy_gone_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a gone metadata proxy resource is logged.

metadata_proxy_length_required_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a missing content-length header triggers logging.

metadata_proxy_entity_too_large_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an oversized metadata request is logged.

metadata_proxy_uri_too_long_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an overly long URI is logged.

metadata_proxy_unsupported_media_type_ti.description: Time (in seconds) after which an unsupported media type is logged.

metadata_proxy_range_not_satisfiable_tim.description: Time (in seconds) after which an unsatisfiable range request is logged.

metadata_proxy_expectation_failed_timeou.description: Time (in seconds) after which an expectation failed is logged.

metadata_proxy_misdirected_request_timeo.description: Time (in seconds) after which a misdirected request is logged.

metadata_proxy_unprocessable_entity_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which an unprocessable entity is logged.

metadata_proxy_locked_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a locked resource is logged.

metadata_proxy_failed_dependency_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a failed dependency is logged.

metadata_proxy_precondition_required_tim.description: Time (in seconds) after which a missing precondition is logged.

metadata_proxy_too_many_requests_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which rate limiting is logged.

metadata_proxy_header_fields_too_large_t.description: Time (in seconds) after which oversized headers are logged.

metadata_proxy_no_response_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which no response is logged.

metadata_proxy_shutdown_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a shutdown is logged.

metadata_proxy_transient_error_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a transient error is logged.

metadata_proxy_ssl_handshake_failed_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which an SSL handshake failure is logged.

metadata_proxy_ssl_timeout_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an SSL timeout is logged.

metadata_proxy_ssl_error_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an SSL error is logged.

metadata_proxy_tls_error_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a TLS error is logged.

metadata_proxy_certificate_error_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate error is logged.

metadata_proxy_expired_certificate_timeo.description: Time (in seconds) after which an expired certificate is logged.

metadata_proxy_revoked_certificate_timeo.description: Time (in seconds) after which a revoked certificate is logged.

metadata_proxy_unknown_certificate_timeo.description: Time (in seconds) after which an unknown certificate is logged.

metadata_proxy_chain_error_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate chain error is logged.

metadata_proxy_self_signed_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a self-signed certificate is logged.

metadata_proxy_hostname_mismatch_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a hostname mismatch is logged.

metadata_proxy_not_yet_valid_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate not yet valid is logged.

metadata_proxy_expired_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate is expired is logged.

metadata_proxy_mismatch_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate mismatch is logged.

metadata_proxy_unknown_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate unknown is logged.

metadata_proxy_revoked_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a certificate is revoked is logged.

ovn_nb_connection.description: Connection string for the OVN Northbound database.

ovn_sb_connection.description: Connection string for the OVN Southbound database.

ovn_metadata_driver.description: Metadata driver class to use for OVN.

ovn_metadata_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the OVN metadata agent.

ovn_metadata_threads.description: Number of threads per worker for OVN metadata operations.

ovn_metadata_proxy_port.description: Port number for the OVN metadata proxy.

ovn_metadata_proxy_user.description: Username for OVN metadata proxy authentication (Keystone v3).

ovn_metadata_proxy_password.description: Password for OVN metadata proxy authentication (Keystone v3).

ovn_metadata_proxy_project_name.description: Project name for OVN metadata proxy authentication (Keystone v3).

ovn_metadata_proxy_auth_url.description: Keystone authentication endpoint URL for the metadata proxy.

ovn_metadata_proxy_auth_type.description: Authentication type for the metadata proxy (e.g., password, token).

ovn_metadata_proxy_region_name.description: Keystone region name used by the metadata proxy.

ovn_metadata_proxy_interface_name.description: Prefix for OVS interface names used by the metadata proxy.

ovn_metadata_proxy_network_type.description: Network type used for metadata traffic (vxlan,Geneve,flat,local).

ovn_metadata_proxy_mtu.description: MTU for metadata traffic overlay networks.

ovn_metadata_proxy_dns_domain.description: DNS domain for metadata-generated DNS records.

ovn_metadata_proxy_dns_servers.description: List of DNS server IPs to configure for metadata instances.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS server.

ovn_metadata_proxy_hostnames.description: List of hostnames to assign to instances via metadata.

ovn_metadata_proxy_gateway_ips.description: List of gateway IP addresses for metadata networks.

ovn_metadata_proxy_ip_ranges.description: List of IP ranges (CIDR) used for metadata subnets.

items.description: CIDR notation for IP range, e.g., 169.254.169.0/24.

ovn_metadata_proxy_security_groups.description: List of security group names/IDs applied to metadata ports.

items.description: Name or UUID of a Neutron security group.

ovn_metadata_proxy_port_security.description: Enable port security on metadata ports.

ovn_metadata_proxy_allowed_address_pairs.description: Enable allowed address pairs on metadata ports.

ovn_metadata_proxy_dhcp_options.description: List of DHCP options (code,value) to apply to metadata subnets.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_network.description: Name or UUID of the Neutron network for metadata traffic.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_subnet.description: Name or UUID of the Neutron subnet for metadata traffic.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_port.description: Name or UUID of the Neutron port bound to metadata service.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_instance.description: Name or UUID of the OVN logical switch port for metadata instance.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_project.description: Project name used for metadata service resources.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_auth_url.description: Keystone endpoint for metadata service authentication.

ovn_metadata_proxy_metadata_auth_type.description: Auth type for metadata service (e.g., password).
